name: EU AI Act — Transparency Obligations (Article 50)
description: Article 50 transparency duties for AI providers and deployers. Informational, not legal advice.

rules.title: Disclosure of AI interaction
rules.description: Natural persons are informed when they interact with an AI system, unless it is obvious from the context.

check.question: Are users clearly informed when they are interacting with an AI system (e.g., chatbot disclosure)?
check.evidence_prompt: Link to the UI disclosure, chatbot banner, or ToS clause.

rules.remediation: Add a clear, conspicuous notice that the user is interacting with AI at the start of the interaction.

rules.title: Machine-readable marking of synthetic content
rules.description: Outputs of AI systems that generate synthetic audio, image, video, or text are marked as artificially generated or manipulated in a machine-readable format.

check.question: Is AI-generated synthetic audio/image/video/text marked in a machine-readable format (e.g., metadata, watermark) as artificially generated?
check.evidence_prompt: Link to the watermarking/metadata implementation or spec.

rules.remediation: Embed machine-readable provenance markers (e.g., C2PA, SynthID-style watermark) in all synthetic outputs.

rules.title: Emotion recognition / biometric categorization notice
rules.description: Persons exposed to an emotion-recognition or biometric-categorization system are informed of its operation.

check.question: Are individuals informed when they are subject to an emotion-recognition or biometric-categorization system?
check.evidence_prompt: Link to the notice shown to exposed persons.

rules.remediation: Provide a clear notice to exposed persons before any emotion-recognition or biometric-categorization processing.

rules.title: Deepfake disclosure
rules.description: Content constituting a deepfake is disclosed as artificially generated or manipulated.

check.question: Is image/audio/video content that constitutes a deepfake disclosed as artificially generated or manipulated?
check.evidence_prompt: Link to the deepfake labelling shown to viewers.

rules.remediation: Label all deepfake content as artificially generated/manipulated in a way visible to the audience.

rules.title: AI-generated public-interest text disclosure
rules.description: AI-generated or manipulated text published to inform the public on matters of public interest is disclosed as AI-generated, absent human review and editorial responsibility.

check.question: Is AI-generated/manipulated text published on matters of public interest disclosed as AI-generated (where there is no human editorial review)?
check.evidence_prompt: Link to the AI-authorship disclosure / editorial policy.

rules.remediation: Disclose AI authorship on public-interest text unless a human holds editorial responsibility for the content.
